title: 2 hours E-Bike with 2-Child Trailer Kissimmee Lakefront Tour
includes: Use of bicycle helmets (youth and adult)
Use of electric pedal-assist mountain bike
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Age 6-13 are not allowed to join the tour. The rider has to be 14 or older and the passengers have to be 2 to 5 years old.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Embark on a lakefront adventure on this electric bike tour and bring along 1 or 2 children ages 1 to 5 years old in the 2-child bike trailer. Holds up to 110 pounds combined weight. The best part is, pedaling is easy with 5 levels of pedal assisted power! 
Your children (or furry friends) will ride along in comfort with mesh ventilation in the front and back of the carrier so they can also enjoy the cool lakefront breeze in their hair. They will be kept safe with two full harness seat belts. Youth helmets will be provided for your use.
During your experience, you are likely to see sandhill cranes, ducks, squirrels, alligators, turtles, a peacock, and sometimes even a random snake.
You will enjoy a journey out to the middle of the lake for the ultimate view, a stop at the sandy beach or playground, and some shopping downtown, ice cream, or some coffee.
This is the ultimate way to experience Florida's nature and wildlife up close and personal at your own pace. This is a self-guided tour.
